title: Front Cover
content: Mass development of the alien Nymphaea lotus (Nymphaea rubra) and Cabomba caroliniana in the thermal effluent of Lake Hévíz, Hungary. The cover image relates to “The knowledge and perceptions of recreational anglers related to alien plant species in freshwater ecosystems: a case study from Hungary” [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70082] by Nagy et al. Photo credit: Balázs Lukács.
